title: Find mid-range engineers
prompt: Return the first_name, title and salary of every employee whose title contains the word Engineer and whose salary is from 110000 to 160000, including both ends.
hints: Senior Engineer contains Engineer but does not start with it.
% can go on both sides of the word. BETWEEN includes both ends.
WHERE title LIKE '%Engineer%' AND salary BETWEEN 110000 AND 160000

wrongAnswers.misconception: Matches only titles that start with Engineer.
Leaves out a salary that sits exactly on a limit.

feedback: Check a Senior Engineer, and an engineer whose salary is exactly 110000.
